subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should this Android feature land as Copy and Select Copy only, or should the first implementation also include Share and Reply actions?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-clear, but the issue proposes four user actions and prior PR attempts used different shapes; maintainers need to choose the product scope before automation or adoption work is safe.

options.title: Copy/Select First
options.body: Implement long-press Copy and Select Copy now, preserving Share and Reply for separate follow-up if maintainers still want them.

options.title: Full Action Sheet
options.body: Approve Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply in one Android message action sheet, accepting the larger UI and validation surface.

options.title: Defer Core UX
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation until broader Android chat interaction patterns are decided.

recommendation.title: Copy/Select First
recommendation.body: Implement long-press Copy and Select Copy now, preserving Share and Reply for separate follow-up if maintainers still want them.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current history signal for Android chat UI work across the affected files.
